about: Public builds of the launcher (TMHUB_PUBLIC_BUILD=1 or TMHUB_RELEASE_PREVIEW=1) apply this list to catalog.json. Rules from docs/legal/permissions.md, checked 2026-11-12 (GitHub licences via the GitHub API). hide: the entry is not shown at all. linkOnly: shown, but the launcher does not download the file itself (no installSpec); the player opens the author's page. noShowcase: the showcase page (third-party pictures without permission) is not used. installLicences: GitHub repositories the launcher may download release files from (OSI licence or my own), checked by check-release.mjs.

hide.mod-tmo-online-patch: Discord attachment only, no licence (and no longer works per its author)
hide.mod-medal-cars: Google Drive share posted on Discord, no licence, no public page
hide.mod-old-in-one: Yandex Disk share posted on Discord, no licence, no public page
hide.mod-nf-to-mp3: Google Drive share posted on Discord, no licence (the launcher downloaded it directly)
hide.mod-trackmania-hub: copy-protection workaround: removed from the catalog source for good, stays here so a re-import is hidden

linkOnly.mod-newsnowcar: author's own site (unlimiter.net), no licence: the player downloads it there
linkOnly.mod-openal-3d-audio: author's own site (files.3zet.net), no licence: the player downloads it there
linkOnly.tas-shweetz-nosepos: GitHub repository without a licence: link only, the player downloads from the author
linkOnly.tas-shweetz-drawfuture: GitHub repository without a licence: link only, the player downloads from the author
linkOnly.tas-shweetz-lowinputbf: GitHub repository without a licence: link only, the player downloads from the author

noShowcase.mod-tmutp: pictures from a repository whose licence GitHub cannot identify (NOASSERTION), no permission for the pictures
